<script>
	$(document).ready(function(){
		var winWidth = $(window).width();

		var mylist = $('.home-brands');
		var listitems = mylist.children('div').get();
		var newItems = listitems;

		if (winWidth < 449) {
			var newItems = listitems.slice(0,9)
			$('.home-brands > div:lt(9)').addClass("active");
		} else if (winWidth >= 450 && winWidth <= 767) {
			var newItems = listitems.slice(0,8)
			$('.home-brands > div:lt(8)').addClass("active");
		} else if (winWidth >= 768 && winWidth <= 991) {
			var newItems = listitems.slice(0,14)
			$('.home-brands > div:lt(14)').addClass("active");
		} else {
			$('.home-brands > div').addClass("active");
		}

		newItems.sort(function(a, b) {
			return $(a).attr('title').toUpperCase().localeCompare($(b).attr('title').toUpperCase());
		})
		$.each(newItems, function(idx, itm) { mylist.append(itm); });
	});
</script>

<div class="consumer-tabs_content">
<div class="active">
<h4>Find the spare parts you need at BuySpares</h4>
<p>For a lot of people, when something breaks or loses a part, the tendency is to simply throw it away. However, it really is not that difficult to locate the spare parts you need and resurrect the item, whether it be a mobile phone, a washing machine or a lawnmower. Here at BuySpares, we have a huge selection of spare parts and appliance spares available, so you can find exactly what you're looking for to fix your household appliances. Having the largest range of appliance parts in the UK, we can help you find exactly what you need, from <a href="/dyson-spares/shop.pl?query=dyson#2">Dyson spares</a> to iPhone cables, and at prices that won't be beaten anywhere else.</p>
</div>
<div>
<h4>A wider choice of appliance parts</h4>
<p>We appreciate it can be very frustrating when an appliance breaks or becomes worn out, which is why we do our best to offer the most comprehensive selection of appliance parts on the Internet, with over 1.5 million products available. We stock appliance spares for an array of items, including kitchen appliances, washers and dryers, computers, and much, much more. Instead of searching around various sites for different spare parts, you can come to BuySpares and find everything you need at once. So, whether you need <a href="/kenwood-spares/shop.pl?query=kenwood#2">Kenwood spares</a> or camera parts, BuySpares has it all.</p>
</div>
<div>
<h4>Save money with appliance spares</h4>
<p>It can be incredibly costly to replace an appliance if it breaks, so why not replace the parts instead and save yourself a considerable amount of money. Why spend hundreds of pounds on a whole new appliance, when a new part will do the trick and only cost you a fraction of the price? By searching for the appliance parts you need, you can save yourself a lot of money, which can then be better spent elsewhere. Our Price Match Guarantee also means that if you find any appliance spares cheaper somewhere else, we'll match the price.</p>
</div>
<div>
<h4>Find appliance parts for all the big brands</h4>
<p>We have spare parts for appliances from over 500 big brand names, including Samsung, Sony, <a href="/hoover-spares/shop.pl#0">Hoover</a>, Apple, <a href="/hotpoint-spares/shop.pl#0">Hotpoint</a>, and many others, so you're sure to find what you need. If a branded product breaks, it can be very expensive to replace a particular part if you go through the supplier, and even more expensive to replace the entire appliance. However, by coming to BuySpares, you can find appliance spares for major brands at vastly reduced prices, so you can save yourself a lot of time, effort and expense. We also stock a large variety of universal fitting and BuySpares approved appliance parts, so you have more choice when finding the parts you need. For everything from <a href="/beko-spares/shop.pl#2">Beko spares</a> to garden appliances, we have the appliance spares, you're looking for.</p>
</div>
<div>
<h4>Unrivalled customer service</h4>
<p>We believe customer service is vitally important, which is why we always do our utmost to ensure 100% customer satisfaction. At BuySpares, we currently have over one million customers, with that number growing all the time. Our dedicated team can help you find the exact appliance parts you need, right down to the model and part number, so you don't have to worry about not finding what you're looking for. We also offer next day delivery on all of our in stock items, so you can get the spare parts you need as soon as you need them.</p>
</div>
<div>
<p>If you're not sure what's causing the fault with your appliance or you aren't able to complete the repair yourself then our partner service, Repaircare, is just what you need. Repaircare is a network of fully trained appliance engineers that operates nationwide. Unlike other repair services, Repaircare only offer fixed price repairs, which means that the price quoted is the price you pay.</p> <a class="rightFloat" href="//www.repaircare.co.uk/" target="_blank" title="repaircare - Get a quote now"> <img alt="repaircare - Get a quote now" src="/images/pubs/content/homepages/buyspares-responsive/en/consumer-tabs/repaircare/consumer-tabs-repaircare.png"/></a> <p class="clearLeft pt10"><strong>A fixed price repair includes:</strong></p><ul class="tick-list"><li>Call-out</li><li>Diagnosis</li><li>Labour</li> <li>Safety check</li><li>All required parts!</li></ul><p></p>
</div>
</div>
